problem:
Which of the following vector spaces has a dimension of $10?$

- ${R}_{10}[t]$, the vector space of all polynomials in the variable $t$ of degree at most $10$
- ${\text{M}}_{5}(R)$, the vector space of all $5\times 5$ matrices over $R$
- ${R}^{10}$

feedback.problem:
Which of the following vector spaces has a dimension of $3?$

- ${R}^{2}$
- ${R}_{2}[t]$, the vector space of all polynomials in the variable $t$ of degree at most $2$
- ${\text{M}}_{3}(R),$ the vector space of all $3\times 3$ matrices over $R$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's examine each of the vector spaces in turn.

- Recall that $\text{dim}({R}^{n})=n.$ Therefore, 

$$
\text{dim}({R}^{2})=2\ne 3.\,\times 
$$
- Recall that $\text{dim}({R}_{n}[t])=n+1.$ Therefore, 

$$
\text{dim}({R}_{2}[t])=2+1=3.\,✓
$$
- Recall that $\text{dim}({\text{M}}_{n}(R))={n}^{2}.$ Therefore, 

$$
\text{dim}({\text{M}}_{3}(R))={3}^{2}=9\ne 3.\,\times 
$$

Hence, the correct answer is "II only."
